**Company Overview**
At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.
  
  
**Department Overview**
The Supply Chain and Procurement organization is a fast-paced and dynamic environment, delivering world-class communications equipment and solutions for customers around the world.
  
  
Our purpose is to deliver exceptional value and customer experience through agility, speed, and collaboration. We plan what products and services are needed, source efficiently and ethically from a diverse supply base, launch new products, make and deliver solutions on time, and exceed customer expectations through outstanding quality, service and support.
  
  
We are designed to bring value, lead technology innovation, and provide Motorola Solutions a competitive advantage on revenue, cost, cash, and delivery.
  
  
**Job Description**
**The Internship will be dedicated to developing and implementing Global Processes within the Global Materials Organization including supplier collaboration, oracle planning cloud and global reporting system governing.**
**It Will Also Include The Following**

- Excellent digital project management skills supporting large scale Transformation Implementations.
- Help draft, update, and standardize global SOPs and training documentation for MSI Supply Chain
- Identify operational bottlenecks, lead time variances, or process hand-off gaps from forecasting to receiving.
- Must be capable of translating objectives into a deliverable strategy to achieve business goals
- Strong analytical skills
- Participate in and lead continuous improvement projects.
- Strong orientation to leadership, teamwork, and positive communication; a flexible, dynamic, self‐demanding and proactive individual, able to motivate him/herself and others

**Additional Qualified Skills**

- Basic AI Literacy: Familiarity with Generative AI platforms (ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude) and practical experience with prompt engineering techniques.
- Data Tools: Hands-on experience with Python (Pandas, Scikit-learn), SQL, or advanced AI capabilities in Excel/Power BI and Google Gemini
- Systems Mindset: Strong curiosity regarding how AI, machine learning, and automation intersect with enterprise ERP environments and business process management.
- ERP/MRP (Oracle, SAP, etc) experience is preferred.

Basic Requirements
  
  

- Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Analytics, Operations, or a related field
- Graduation date not later then Dec.2029

Travel Requirements
  
  
Under 10%
  
  
Relocation Provided
  
  
None
  
  
Position Type
  
  
Experienced
  
  
***EEO Statement***
Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.
  
  
We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.
  
  
We’re committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience for candidates with disabilities, or other physical or mental health conditions. To request an accommodation, please complete this Reasonable Accommodations Form so we can assist you.

- 7+ years of enterprise technology sales experience.
- 10+ years of enterprise technology sales experience.

**Job Title:**
Business Operations Analyst
  
  
**Team:**
Operations
  
  
**Location:**
Onsite - Sawtelle (Between Santa Monica & West LA)
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Fulltime, Salary, Exempt
  
  
**Reports To:**
Sr. Director Marketing Operations
  
  
**About Plug**
Plug is an automotive fintech startup building the marketplace for electric vehicles. Consumers, dealers, and commercial partners trade in, sell, and auction used EVs through a platform built exclusively for electric, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive.
  
  
Consumers can get an instant cash offer in minutes, backed by data-driven pricing, battery state-of-health analysis, with pickup, payment, and title transfer handled end-to-end. Franchise and independent dealers across the United States bid in real time on inventory sourced directly from these consumers, dealers, and commercial partners. The result is a single platform that gives sellers a fast, fair exit and gives dealers a dedicated channel for sourcing used EV inventory.
  
  
Founded in 2023 and led by former Tesla executives, Plug has facilitated $100M in EV sales since launch and is backed by a $20M Series A from Lightspeed Venture Partners. We're building the most AI-native startup team in Los Angeles, full of operators, engineers, and ML researchers laying the transaction rails for the used EV market's exponential growth.
  
  
****Why Plug****

- You'll own a piece of the biggest infrastructure opportunity in automotive.
- You'll work on a platform built exclusively for EVs, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive.
- You'll be part of an AI-native company. We're rethinking how work gets done at a fundamental level.
- You'll work directly with operators who have scaled multi-billion dollar businesses in automotive, EV, and marketplaces.
- You'll have real ownership, high autonomy, and a direct line to company outcomes.

****The Opportunity****
You'll report to the Director of Business Operations and be the go-to person for turning data into decisions. You'll build and maintain the dashboards and models that track how the business is performing, prepare the analysis and slides that go in front of leadership, and use AI tools - including building your own lightweight agents and automations over time - to enhance your workflow and support broader AI adoption across the organization.
  
  
You'll support the Director of BizOps on cross-functional initiatives and KPI tracking, bringing depth and speed on the numbers to the work.
  
  
****What You’ll Own****
**Analytics & Reporting**

- Build and maintain BI dashboards (Metabase/Snowflake or equivalent) covering auction performance, dealer operations, vehicle flow, and pricing
- Define and track success metrics for BizOps-led initiatives, so leaders always know whether a project is actually working
- Build clear, exec-ready slides and reports for recurring leadership reviews

**AI & Workflow Automation**

- Use AI tools to speed up and automate recurring analysis and reporting work.
- Build lightweight agents or automated pipelines for repeatable requests.
- Bring a builder's mindset to your own workflow and workflow of other teams

**Analysis & Business Partnership**

- Run deep-dive analyses to explain why a metric moved
- Translate data into a clear point of view for non-technical stakeholders

****What You Are****

- 2-3 years of experience in business operations, data analytics, strategy & ops, or a similarly analytical role (marketplace or automotive experience a plus, not required).
- Hands-on comfort building dashboards in a BI tool (Metabase, Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent).
- Curiosity and hands-on comfort with AI tools for analysis and workflow automation
- Strong slide-building and communication skills — you can turn a messy dataset into something a VP can read in ten seconds.
- Business acumen: you understand why a metric matters to the business, not just how to compute it.
- Build the analytical backbone of a company at the center of the EV transition.
- Ship work quickly and see the impact of your analysis show up in real decisions, fast.
- Work directly with operators who've scaled multi-billion-dollar businesses in automotive, EV, and marketplaces.
- Join a team that values clarity, ownership, and a bias toward action.

**Compensation And Benefits**
Annual salary: L2 $85,000 - $105,000
  
  
*Salary ranges reflect independent, third-party benchmarking against national compensation data. Where an individual's actual offer falls within that range depends on a combination of factors, including relevant experience, specialized skills, training and qualifications, current business needs, and prevailing market conditions. Ranges are reviewed periodically and may be adjusted to reflect changing market conditions.*
Benefits & Perks:
  
  

- Health, Vision, and Dental insurance
- 401(k) plan
- Daily lunch stipend
- Equity (based on role and performance)
- Unlimited PTO
- Fully stocked kitchen
- Dog-friendly office
- 30-day remote work from anywhere policy
- Ongoing opportunities for growth and development

This full-time position is based in Sawtelle (between Santa Monica and West Los Angeles) and is an in-person role. We welcome candidates from all locations to apply, provided they are willing to relocate for the role. Relocation assistance will not be provided for successful candidates. Sponsorship not available at this time.
  
  
**Acknowledgments**
Plug is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We believe diverse teams build better products - full stop.

The Vice President, Adoption & Services is a critical member of the Client Partnerships Senior Leadership Team. The two key purposes of our Client Partnerships team are:

- To drive platform adoption by our clients, which are K12 schools, districts, and state education agencies across the United States, in support of their strategic priorities
- To retain and expand our relationship with every client

The VP, Adoption & Services owns the adoption purpose. The Vice President, Account Management is their peer and counterpart and owns the retention and expansion purpose. Both report to the Chief Client Officer.

This role leads the team most directly responsible to help educators use our platform to improve student outcomes. This is the promise we make to our clients, and it is evergreen. Clients' needs change, so their priorities shift each school year and even within a school year. We adapt to clients' evolving goals with thoughtful changes in how we support them with our products and services. We guide clients and are guided by them, consistently both sharing best practice and learning how we can serve them better.

The VP, Adoption & Services shows deep expertise in strategic planning, operational leadership, cross-functional coordination, people leadership, direct client engagement, executive presence, and initiative ownership. The role is focused on delivering results rather than completing tasks. Its North Star metric of success is client platform adoption, as measured by the health of each use case a client expects our platform to perform for them.

This role owns not only the adoption strategy but the operation that delivers it: a large, distributed professional services and implementation organization responsible for delivering initial and ongoing services for every client.

Key Responsibilities

**Platform Adoption Strategy & Vision**

- Own the platform adoption strategy for all K-12 district clients, translating the North Star metric — use-case health — into concrete team priorities
- Define what "adoption success" looks like for each client segment and build the frameworks that let the team diagnose adoption health at scale
- Partner with the Chief Client Officer; the VP, Account Management; and Product leadership to align adoption strategy with retention and expansion goals, ensuring the two halves of Client Partnership pull in the same direction with our Technology team
- Anticipate shifts in district priorities (state policy changes, funding cycles, school-year rhythms) and adjust the adoption playbook proactively rather than reactively
- Set and track the metrics, targets, and reporting cadence that make adoption progress visible to the CCO and the broader leadership team

**Service Delivery & Implementation Leadership**

- Own and operate the professional services and implementation organization end-to-end, delivering onboarding and ongoing service for every client, at national scale
- Build and maintain a repeatable, multiproduct implementation and services operation that delivers consistent, high-quality service across hundreds of simultaneous client engagements; includes  staffing models, capacity planning, project management systems, quality standards
- Partner with Revenue, Finance, and Product on services development strategy, including: pricing, packaging, attach strategy, margins, cost-to-serve and when services should be included vs. sold separately.
- Set and manage budget, headcount, and utilization targets for the delivery organization, balancing cost-to-serve against adoption outcomes
- Establish clear service-delivery standards and SLAs, and hold the organization accountable to them
- Build the escalation and risk-management processes that catch delivery problems before they become client-health problems

**People Leadership**

- Build, coach, and retain a high-performing team of professional services practitioners across a national client base
- Set clear expectations and growth paths for direct reports; develop the next layer of adoption leadership
- Create a team culture that balances client empathy with disciplined execution, guiding clients while holding a clear point of view
- Identify skill and capacity gaps across the team and make the hiring, training, or restructuring calls needed to close them
- Model the executive presence and client-facing standard the team is expected to meet

**AI Fluency & Adoption Leadership**

- Use AI tools fluently in your own daily work (e.g. for client prep and communication to data synthesis and problem-solving) and hold that same standard for the team
- Lead the team's evolutionary AI adoption: identifying where AI can make existing workflows faster, more consistent, or higher quality (e.g., account health analysis, client communication drafting, meeting synthesis) and building the habits and tools that make that the default way of working
- Lead the team's transformative AI adoption, asking what becomes possible for platform adoption that wasn't possible before, like new service models, new ways of diagnosing client needs, new leverage per team member. Champion the bets worth making
- Set a clear point of view on where AI should and shouldn't be used in client-facing work, balancing speed and scale against the judgment, trust, and human connection clients expect from Panorama
- Partner with Product, Engineering, and other functions piloting AI capabilities to ensure Platform Adoption is an early, thoughtful adopter by personally testing, giving feedback, and scaling what works
- Build team fluency and comfort with AI tools through modeling, training, and clear expectations; treat AI literacy as a core skill for every member of the team

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

- Serve as the primary point of coordination between the Professional Services organization and Product, Engineering, and Technical Services on everything that affects clients' ability to adopt and use the platform
- Ensure adoption insights and client feedback make their way into product roadmap conversations, and that product changes are translated into adoption plans before they reach clients
- Represent your team's priorities, constraints, and client insights in cross-functional planning forums
- Build strong working relationships with peer leaders across the organization to speed up alignment and avoid duplicated effort

**Direct Client Engagement & Executive Presence**

- Engage directly with district superintendents, administrators, and other senior client stakeholders on strategic adoption conversations, especially for the largest or highest-risk accounts
- Represent Panorama's point of view on platform adoption best practices in client-facing settings, conferences, and executive briefings
- Step into escalated or high-stakes client situations where executive involvement changes the outcome
- Balance guiding clients toward proven adoption practices with genuinely listening to and adapting for what each district needs

**Operational Excellence & Initiative Ownership**

- Build and continuously improve the operating systems (playbooks, dashboards, health scoring, cadences) that let the adoption team scale without losing quality
- Directly lead high-impact initiatives that improve adoption outcomes, from scoping through measurement of results
- Identify bottlenecks in how the team supports clients and drive the process changes needed to remove them
- Deliver results, not just activity, holding the team and the initiative portfolio accountable to measurable adoption outcomes, not task completion

**Requirements**

- 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in client success, account management, or professional services, ideally in K-12 education, SaaS, or another relationship-driven, outcomes-based industry
- Demonstrated experience personally owning and scaling a large, complex service delivery or implementation operation — including staffing, budgeting, and operational rigor at scale — not just an adoption or client-success function
- Track record of driving measurable adoption, usage, or outcome improvements at scale across a diverse client base
- Experience operating at the senior leadership level, including direct engagement with C-suite or superintendent-level client stakeholders
- Demonstrated personal fluency with AI tools in daily professional work, and experience leading a team through AI adoption — both incremental workflow improvements and more fundamental changes to how work gets done
- Strong cross-functional experience partnering with Product, Engineering, and other revenue-adjacent functions
- Familiarity with the K-12 education landscape — district structures, school-year rhythms, and the pressures facing educators — is a strong plus
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the judgment to adapt messaging for different audiences, from frontline educators to executive stakeholders

**Benefits**

**Base Salary:**
The base salary range for this position is $204,000 - $300,000. Our salary is just one component of Panorama's competitive total rewards strategy that also includes annual bonuses or commission awards, equity awards, as well as other region-specific health and welfare benefits

Some of the additional benefits offered are:

- 401K with an employer match
- Health, dental, vision, life insurance, and short-term and long-term disability coverage.
- Flexible spending account for health care and dependent care
- Wellness Reimbursement
- Work from Home Reimbursement
- Flexible vacation policy
- Parental leave program
- Company Issued Laptop

*Help advance CATCH Global Foundation (“CATCH”) as an ed tech leader, delivering innovative digital health & wellness curricula to school districts worldwide. Annually, CATCH reaches over 4,000,000 kids with users in 30 countries and counting.*

CATCH is a nonprofit organization with the mission to empower educators with curriculum, training, and ongoing support to foster communities that thrive in mind, heart, and body. It offers evidence-based and evidence-informed programs and professional development in various content areas (health education, physical education, vaping prevention, Social Emotional Learning, whole child wellness, etc.).

CATCH curriculum is delivered and managed via several web applications (e.g. , ) which together deliver approximately 500,000 lessons per school year. We are seeking a Technology Manager to lead development, maintenance, and support across our platforms and internal tech infrastructure.

In this role, you will work directly with our Senior Director of Technology & Design to:

- Manage an offshore development team (one primary developer) and ticketing system to execute feature builds, bug fixes, and platform maintenance
- Contribute to system architecture and application documentation
- Proactively identify and mitigate technology risks and solutions
- Participate in our Technology Advisory group which includes a member of our Board of Directors
- Work with a cybersecurity firm (on retainer) to harden cybersecurity posture
- Oversee AI governance & support AI adoption
- Manage hardware inventory, setup/wiping, and provisioning
- Configure and monitor Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) & email security software
- Configure user directory and roles
- Oversee web file storage and data backups
- Complete district DPAs and tech questionnaires
- Monitor tech stack health and track upcoming version updates
- Provide occasional internal tech support
- Other duties as assigned

**Skills and Requirements**

- Bachelor's in a technical field or equivalent experience, plus 3+ years managing technical staff (employees or contractors)
- Foundational knowledge of full-stack web development
- Experience with core IT operations a plus—e.g., hardware provisioning/lifecycle management, user directory/identity administration, endpoint security tools (EDR), etc.
- Cybersecurity certification and/or experience preferred
- Ability to oversee and coordinate complex projects independently and under deadline
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills

While our organization was founded in Austin TX, we are a 100% virtual work environment. We have regular in-person retreats (travel/lodging provided) to help us develop and grow together as a team, as well as get to know one another on a more personal level. Day-to-day, you can expect to interface with the rest of the CATCH team via video/voice calls, email, and Slack.

**Job Classification:** Full-Time (Exempt)

**Location:** Remote

**Salary:** $80,000-85,000

**Benefits:** 401K, HSA (with employer contributions available), 100% employer-covered health insurance (other opt-in benefits available), unlimited vacation policy, 12-week paid maternity/paternity leave, and work from home with flexible scheduling.

**To apply please send resume and cover letter to: jobs@catch.org.**

Pay: $80,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year

Benefits:

- 401(k)
- Dental insurance
- Flexible schedule
- Flexible spending account
- Health insurance
- Health savings account
- Life insurance

- Professional development assistance

- Vision insurance

**Job Description:**

The **Manager - Software Engineering (Account Opening & Customer**) leads multiple teams responsible for developing, maintaining, and supporting software solutions and processes used for account opening and customer relationships. This role partners closely with Product, Project Management, Architecture, and Engineering teams to ensure successful project delivery while driving operational efficiency, automation, AI adoption, and continuous improvement for these teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Lead, mentor, and develop a team supporting account opening and customer initiatives.
- Oversee software development, maintenance, and technical processes related to these teams.
- Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure successful implementation and delivery outcomes.
- Drive process improvements, automation initiatives, and operational efficiency efforts.
- Support system integrations and technical delivery processes.
- Foster collaboration and effective communication among technical and business stakeholders.
- Ensure project commitments, quality standards, and customer expectations are met throughout each team project.
- Support the strategic adoption of AI and intelligent automation within these teams, identifying opportunities to streamline activities, reduce manual effort, improve accuracy, and accelerate client implementations through data-driven process optimization.
- Champion continuous improvement initiatives by leveraging AI-enabled tools, analytics, and workflow automation to increase team productivity, enhance scalability, and deliver measurable operational efficiencies.

**Required Qualifications**

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
- 6+ years of experience in software development.
- Experience developing REST APIs using C#, .NET, Java, Python, Node.js, or similar technologies.
- Understanding of API security concepts, including OAuth2 and JWT.
- Experience with SQL and relational databases.
- Proven leadership and people management experience.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Understanding of software development, system integration, and technical delivery processes.
- Experience using AI-enabled development and project management tools, including Azure DevOps.
- Experience working within Agile methodologies and software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills with both technical and business stakeholders.
- Ability to build effective partnerships across teams and departments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

- Experience leading process improvement, automation, or operational efficiency initiatives.
- Strong preference for candidates with FinTech industry experience.

data.description:
**Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

As a trusted C-Suite / senior executive level advisor on ServiceNow offerings, the Principal Customer Success Executive (PCSE) owns the post-sale customer relationship, aiming to increase customer satisfaction and drive retention through Impact delivery. Principal CSEs are experienced individuals who bring a consultative, problem-solving approach to partnering with senior customer stakeholders to derive value from our platforms. They demonstrate a strong understanding of customer’s industry and specific business strategies, driving alignment between these factors and what ServiceNow can offer to enable better business outcomes for their customers. This role drives business transformation by maximizing the long-term strategic value of ServiceNow and ensuring that every aspect of the customer’s platform and capability are ready for expansion.

They provide strategic direction and mentorship to both customers and ServiceNow teams managing complex, multi-workstream programs. They play a pivotal role in resolving escalations and mitigating risks, ensuring adoption and usage is maintained at healthy levels. Principal CSEs focus on ensuring the customer recognizes the value of the ServiceNow Platform at all levels and stages, facilitating a smooth path to both renewal and up- and cross-sell.

Overall, Principal CSEs are responsible for fostering the relationship with C-suite level stakeholders in a smaller number of strategically important Impact accounts, with the aim of increasing customer satisfaction and driving retention and upgrades, where applicable.

**What You Get to Do in This Role:**

- Lead high-complexity transformations in our largest and most strategic customers, ensuring all ServiceNow Customer Excellence roles align and deliver in accordance with governance frameworks, customer objectives, and organizational priorities; ultimately chaperoning Impact value management and demonstrating strategic oversight.
- Proactively identify professional services pipeline opportunities through product capabilities road mapping, value blueprints and adoption analysis, providing pre-sales support for funnel opportunities as requested.
- Partner with Impact team members (e.g., Customer Success Managers or other Customer Success Executives) leveraging the joint visibility of customer insights to create executive-ready narratives and platform value stories.
- Work with senior executives to shape and influence customer organizational strategy by identifying emerging trends, refining best practices, aligning delivery approaches with evolving market demands, and providing industry-specific thought leadership.
- Drive operational consistency and excellence by standardizing delivery methodologies and ensuring adherence to governance and quality standards, interfacing with Delivery as required. Advise on change management plans to support strong post-delivery adoption.
- Establish relationships with ServiceNow leaders, advocating for product evolution based on customer insights, and mentoring other Customer Success resources on transformation best practices.
- Identify areas of risk and take steps to prevent customer or revenue churn.
- Work closely with Sales Teams to define and execute product adoption and customer retention plans.
- Provide prescriptive guidance on internal project/program governance and help the customer create the appropriate governance models and ensure adherence.
- Help the customer identify incidents where contractual SLAs were missed and take necessary action.
- Improve overall customer satisfaction, as well as the satisfaction of their internal customers.

  
**Qualifications**

**To be successful in this role you have:**

- Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
- Significant experience collaborating with senior IT and business leaders, with a track record of successfully translating corporate strategy/objectives with the applied use of ServiceNow technology in the context of the client’s environment.
- PMP preferred; project management experience required.
- Minimum 15+ years in client-facing roles with a focus on account management, consulting, or transformation leadership throughout all phases. Experience in executive-level leadership roles, with a proven track record of influencing senior stakeholders and driving strategic outcomes, is strongly preferred.
- Experience supporting or working with U.S. Federal customers preferred
- Experience in any of the following critical subject areas, with a demonstrated history delivering consulting services:
  - IT Strategy and Planning
  - IT Operations and Management
  - Human Resources
  - Security Operations
  - Customer Service Management
  - IT Processes
  - IT Governance
  - IT Portfolio, Program and Project Management
  - IT Project Delivery (SDLC) and adoption
- Experience with project problem diagnosis, solution development, client communications, facilitation of decision making, documentation, managing client expectations, and team leadership.
- Independently leverages AI to optimize workflows, tailor customer solutions, and inform strategic decisions.
- Articulates AI system design, ethical implications, and platform use cases clearly, guiding peers and stakeholders in responsible, value-driven AI adoption.

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of **$180,200 - $281,600**, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.

 **Additional Information**

**Work Personas**

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

**Accommodations**

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

**Export Control Regulations**

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.
